title: He’s English, Buck Mulligan said, and he thinks we ought to speak Irish in Ireland.
html_source:
Despite being an Englishmen, Haines speaks Gaelic while the old woman delivering milk cannot.

Buck is making a reference to the cultural nationalist perspective of “Gaelic Revivalism”
